description: One publish ATTEMPT for a release, at releases/{sha}/provenance/{run_id}-{run_attempt}.json. Split out of release.json by I9786: these three fields move on every rebuild of the same commit, so keeping them in the immutable identity record made a re-run of an unchanged commit an unconditional ReleaseImmutabilityError. Immutable-checked only WITHIN one attempt's own key: a second, distinct run_id/run_attempt for an already-published sha is EXPECTED to differ here and is written as its own durable record; two writes naming the SAME run_id/run_attempt with differing bytes are refused.

built_at.description: When this attempt ran. Gotcha (I9786): sourced from github.event.repository.updated_at in deploy.yml, which is repository metadata, not the build instant -- deploy.yml should source this from github.run_started_at instead.
built_at.title: Built At

run_attempt.description: Distinguishes a 're-run failed jobs' retry that reuses the same run_id. Part of this document's own key.
run_attempt.title: Run Attempt

run_id.description: The CI run that produced this attempt (GitHub's GITHUB_RUN_ID). Part of this document's own key.
run_id.title: Run Id

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema. A consumer that cannot read the version refuses the document rather than guessing.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

sha.description: The commit this attempt built. Must match the release.json this attempt accompanies.
sha.title: Sha

test_summary.description: The foundation-test line this attempt printed. Free text; not parsed by anything downstream.
test_summary.title: Test Summary

workflow_run_url.description: The specific workflow run this attempt is. Different on every attempt by construction.
workflow_run_url.title: Workflow Run Url

title: Crucible release provenance, v1
